text: Students in this major mainly study basic theory and knowledge of aeronautical engineering, master basic knowledge, specialized knowledge and engineering skills in basic principles and engineering application of aircrafts and aircraft engines, accept the comprehensive training in the aspect of aeronautical engineering, possess basic ability to skillfully apply computer-aided design and analysis manners to conduct aeronautical engineering experiment test, operation and maintenance, have the innovation consciousness and the ability to independently study for further development, and are able to engage in the maintenance of aircrafts and engines in the fields of aeronautical engineering and mechanical engineering as well as the design and production of electromechanical products.
